blocks.s: Complaint
The following complaints can occur during or after programming the PMA control unit:
A fault message is displayed when programming the PMA control unit.
A programming abort takes place.
The PMA control unit cannot be programmed.
No communication is possible with the PMA control unit after programming.
Cause
Control unit software
Solution
Disconnect the PMA control unit from the vehicle electrical system or disconnect the ground cable of the vehicle battery.
After reconnecting the control unit or the ground cable, check whether trouble-free communication with the PMA control unit is now possible again.
If trouble-free communication is possible again, program the PMA control unit again.
If communication with the control unit is still not possible, the PMA control unit must be renewed.

blocks.s: The front passenger airbag can be deactivated using the airbag switch. An indicator lamp also lights up to indicate that the airbag has been deactivated. Activation and deactivation are the exclusive responsibility of the customer!
The airbag switch can only be activated/deactivated by means of the ignition key when the vehicle is stationary and the door is open.
The airbag switch
assumes the form of a two-wire Hall switch,
receives its power supply from the Safety and Information Module,
is monitored continuously during vehicle operation.

The indicator lamp is controlled by the Safety and Information Module. The indicator lamp is activated when the airbag switch relays the status "Passenger Airbag OFF". The indicator lamp is diagnosed and monitored. If the system detects a malfunction in the power supply or the bulb, a fault entry occurs in the Safety and Information Module and the airbag warning lamp is also switched on!
The front passenger airbag deactivation switch is a two-wire Hall switch monitored by the Safety and Information Module. A fault entry with storage of a DTC occurs in the event of malfunction.

The front passenger airbag deactivation switch receives clocked voltage from the Safety and Information Module. The correct voltage curve as measured at the Safety and Information Module is shown below. For the voltage measurement, the adapter lead must not be connected to the passenger's airbag deactivation switch!
GRA-PIX-FB6110061.png
Comparison images for oscilloscope measurement
Select test probe 1 in Source.
All work on the airbags must be carried out with the battery clamped off!
Connect and disconnect all BYTEFLIGHT control units, sensors and alternators only with the battery disconnected!

If a fibre-optic cable on the BYTEFLIGHT bus has to be repaired, it must be borne in mind that there may only be one join in a fibre-optic cable. If there is already a join due to a door connector, the fibre-optic cable must not be repaired. In the case of a defect, the fibre-optic cable must be replaced!
